title: Sale spanning two lots: older lot long-term (12.5 %), newer lot short-term (20 %); buy and sell charges under s.48
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.48 (i) expenditure in connection with transfer deducted; (ii) cost of acquisition includes incidental acquisition cost (brokerage/stamp). STT is NOT deductible (s.48 fifth proviso, inserted by Finance Act 2004) - the charges here are brokerage/stamp only
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso: listed equity short-term if held not more than 12 months (day of acquisition excluded, General Clauses Act 1897 s.9)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.111A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: STCG 20 % for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: LTCG above Rs 1,25,000 at 12.5 % for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2018 s.2(11); Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Sale 2025-05-20: 150 @ 300.00 = 45,000.00 gross, sell charges 30.00; charges apportioned by quantity: 100/150 x 30 = 20.00 to lot A part, 50/150 x 30 = 10.00 to lot B part.
Open lot: lot B 100 - 50 = 50 units @ 250.00 acquired 2025-01-10.
